artifact: FSAR S3-C0 Cross-Fold Response Identity Control V1

candidate_corpus_policy.reason: The retrieval corpus itself is TRAIN-only and is considered an indexed corpus available to all internal query folds. Ranking supervision remains query-specific.

future_loss_identity_control.rule: For validation fold f, mask future auxiliary loss on any training factual pair whose gold response identity occurs as a gold response in fold f.

required_post_mask_gate: Each ordinal threshold must retain both binary classes in every training fold.
